testo:
■ If you have the 2 King Cells of "King's Thoughts" and "King's Fighting Spirit" in your hand or mana zone, you may pay this creature's cost to combine them and summon this King Creature.

■ Whenever you use "Guard Strike", you may put the top card of your deck into your mana zone.
